title: High-dose chemotherapy with autologous bone-marrow/stem-cell rescue for breast cancer: adoption, randomized reversal, and treatment-mortality burden
summary: Promotes the seed case of bone-marrow transplant/high-dose chemotherapy for breast cancer as a medical reversal after adoption. The record tracks the evidentiary route from dose-intensification plausibility and nonrandomized enthusiasm to randomized and pooled evidence showing no overall-survival advantage in aggregate and substantial treatment-related mortality. It is scoped to breast-cancer treatment, not to hematopoietic transplant in other diseases.
